value.draft: Travel reimbursement for trial participants depends on the trial's funding source, which may cover travel expenses as part of the study's budget. You should review the participant agreement to see if travel reimbursement is outlined, including eligible expenses and required documentation. If details are unclear, contact the trial site directly for specific policies and procedures regarding travel reimbursement. Always confirm the terms with the study team to ensure you understand what is covered.
